{"name": "run_python", "arguments": {"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_parsed'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_only = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
completed_cleaned = completed_only[completed_only['revenue_parsed'] != 999999.99]

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_cleaned['revenue_parsed'].mean()

# Print the required values
print("Number of completed orders:", len(completed_only))
print("Number of QA orders:", (sales['revenue_parsed'] == 999999.99).sum())
print("Number of completed orders after removing QA orders:", len(completed_cleaned))
print("Mean revenue of completed orders (after cleaning):"," , mean_revenue)"}}
